title: Doctoral INPhINIT Fellowships Retaining 2027
about: "la Caixa" Foundation call for 30 doctoral fellowships in any discipline at universities or research centres in Spain or Portugal, open to researchers of any nationality who meet the mobility rule. Fellows start between September and November 2027.
requirements: Resided or carried out main activity in Spain/Portugal for more than twelve months in the three years before the deadline
Within the first four years (full-time equivalent) of research career at the deadline

upskill.name: AI for Education Academy page
why: No course covers the stated eligibility rules (nationality, mobility, career stage); fallback to the closest Academy page

"Within the first four years (full-time equivalent) of research career" (early-stage researchers, any discipline) → AI for Education Academy course A010.07: "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
